map.🧾 累计预扣（可选，按当前月薪回推）: 🧾 Cumulative withholding (optional, inferred from current monthly salary)
map.按累计预扣法，累计应纳税所得额 = 本月初累计收入 + 本月收入 − 累计五险一: Under cumulative withholding, cumulative taxable income = YTD income before this month + current-month income − cumulative social insurance − cumulative basic deduction (threshold × months) − cumulative itemized deductions. Current-month withholding = cumulative tax − tax already withheld. Cumulative insurance and itemized deductions default to this month’s amount × months; enter cumulative values directly if earlier amounts differ.
map.累计预扣按本月工资、社保与专项附加扣除同口径回推；前期金额不同可直接填写累计值。: Cumulative withholding is inferred from this month’s salary, insurance and itemized deductions; enter cumulative values directly if earlier amounts differ.
map.累计应纳税额低于已预扣税额，本月应预扣为 0；多缴部分在年度汇算时处理。: Cumulative tax is lower than tax already withheld, so withholding this month is 0; the excess is settled in the annual reconciliation.
map.当前月份须为 1–12 的整数，累计预扣不计算。: Current month must be an integer from 1 to 12; cumulative withholding is not calculated.
map.累计收入、已预扣税额与累计五险一金须为非负数字。: YTD income, withheld tax and cumulative social insurance must be non-negative numbers.
map.按累计预扣法核算本月应预扣个税（输入当前月份、本月初累计收入与已预扣税额）: Calculate this month’s withholding under the cumulative method (enter current month, YTD income and tax already withheld)
map.累计预扣和普通月薪计算有什么区别？: How does cumulative withholding differ from the ordinary monthly estimate?
map.普通月薪计算按单月应纳税所得额套月度折算税率，适合快速估算；累计预扣按年初至本月: The ordinary estimate applies the monthly converted rate to one month’s taxable income; cumulative withholding applies the annual rate table to YTD cumulative income, then subtracts tax already withheld to get this month’s withholding, consistent with monthly employer filing.
